zh-Hans: 在空间或从手记打开化学工程，画出分子并打开“三维预览”。修改结构后重新生成，保存并重开工程。在空间新建建筑工程，画两段相连的墙、拖动端点、修改一侧饰面，保存重开，再分别另存建筑与 CAD 副本。新建一个只有名称的游戏工程，在工程中导入游戏包，查看引擎依据、尝试项目助手并确认根目录。打开旧聊天，查看日期并一键复制自己发的多行消息。在串口助手中用测试设备验证 Modbus 读写线圈和寄存器及报文转换。 DeepSeek 云端供应商中试用转写与朗读，切换深度思考搜索。填写内网 HTTP 端点，验证取消和确认保存。图片工作台试用涂抹组的羽化笔刷、切换工具栏列数，并用 Pencil 配合双指导航。在手记或 PDF 分别调整普通笔与荧光笔，再到 Skill Hub 创建、导入并重开草稿。
en-US: Open a chemistry project from Space or a note. Draw a molecule and open 3D Preview. Edit the structure, regenerate the preview, save and reopen. Create a building project in Space. Draw two connected walls, move an endpoint, change one face finish, save and reopen, then save building and CAD copies. Create a game project with only a name, import a game package, review the engine detection evidence, try the project assistant and confirm the root. Open an old chat and copy a multiline message with one tap. Use a test device to check Modbus coil and register operations and frame conversion in the serial assistant. Try DeepSeek transcription and speech output, and toggle thinking search. Enter an HTTP endpoint on your LAN and check both Cancel and Verify and Continue. In the image workbench, try the Feather brush under Smudge, switch toolbar columns and use Pencil with two-finger navigation. In Notes or a PDF, adjust a pen and highlighter separately. From the Skill Hub, create or import a Skill and reopen a draft.
